ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 0.25:1 ratio of high-intensity white pixels to low-intensity dark-grey/black pixels.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Non-uniform distribution of high-contrast white circular blobs across a dark field; higher density of blobs on the left lobe's medial and lateral regions; right lobe exhibits more isolated, discrete spots.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration pattern along the entire trailing edge with vertical pixel amplitudes ranging from 3 to 12 pixels.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve trajectory from the median notch to the distal tips of both lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Massive colonization of barnacles (Coronulidae) covering approximately 35-40% of the visible fluke surface area.
